gbm_population_evidence.quote: in Patients With Solid Neoplasms (Endometrium, Kidney, Glioblastoma, Colorectal, Ovary and Lung).

candidate_evidence.quote: This is multicentric, interventional, non farmacological and prospective study.

[DEVICE] CLG: The development of an innovative device (CLG) consisting of an aqueous gel based on hyaluronic acid and commercially available (Belotero) able to be loaded and to release chemokine CXCL12

biomarkers.biomarker_other: CXCR4+ circulating tumour cells; epithelial-mesenchymal markers (EPCAM, SNAIL, vimentin, N-/E-cadherin)

source_quote.quote: Expression analysis of Epithelium-Mesenchymal Markers (EPCAM, SNAIL, VIMENTIN, N-CADERIN, E-CADERIN) will be performed using Real-Time PCR.

coder_notes: Non-pharmacological, phase NA study of an ex vivo CTC-capture device (hyaluronic acid gel loaded with CXCL12) applied to patients' blood; no drug is administered to patients, so no agent rows. Glioblastoma named in the official title among eligible solid tumours, so basket_gbm_eligible, though conditions say only 'Neoplasm Malignant'. Treatment setting coded recurrent from 'advanced ... with metastases' (C10), not really applicable.
